Sound sources (CC0 1.0):
Ice moving in glass — Rvgerxini
https://freesound.org/people/Rvgerxini/sounds/464451/
50 RPG sound effects — Kenney
https://opengameart.org/content/50-rpg-sound-effects
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Edited for dovemayo: short excerpts, mono conversion, EQ, level matching, fades.
Ice samples: ice-0/1/2. Book flips: paper-0/1/2. Cloth: cloth-0/1. Book close: soft.

Additional sources (CC0 1.0):
Bubbles pop: https://opengameart.org/content/bubbles-pop
Wine Glasses on contact (Clink) — EpicWizard: https://freesound.org/people/EpicWizard/sounds/325194/
Underwater Ambience — Kinoton: https://freesound.org/people/Kinoton/sounds/393819/
Bubble/wine excerpts equalized and faded; underwater excerpt filtered and crossfaded into a loop. Tooth and shoe use Kenney book flip and footstep recordings.

Clarity revision: wine-clear isolates the 3.08 kHz wineglass ring; underwater-clear removes sub-260 Hz rumble and retains water detail up to 3.5 kHz. Same CC0 sources above.

Additional CC0 sources, edited excerpts:
Apple - bite 01 — Anthousai: https://freesound.org/people/Anthousai/sounds/398756/
Page Turn (1) — OwlStorm: https://freesound.org/people/OwlStorm/sounds/151220/
WaterBottle.wav — MCYost: https://freesound.org/s/146334/ (beer and non-vocal low water gag)
Bubbles 001.wav — ristooooo1: https://freesound.org/s/539823/ (six separate bubbles)
44.1 kHz excerpts, gentle filtering, level matching and edge fades. No human voice used for eggplant.

Softer sound revision:
Beer pour: water-pour-01 from Fantasy Sound Effects (Tinysized SFX), CC0: https://opengameart.org/content/fantasy-sound-effects-tinysized-sfx
Chili: Catching fire, CC0: https://opengameart.org/content/catching-fire
Page-soft: prior OwlStorm source, softened EQ and longer fade-in.
Bubble-deep and tooth-soft: prior ristooooo1 water-bubble source, pitch/filter/envelope edits.

LP-style cues: lp-place and lp-lift are designed from the existing CC0 Kenney cloth, book-close and footstep recordings above; layered, band-limited, softly faded. They are a designed turntable handling impression, not a literal turntable recording.

User-selected LP replacements (Pixabay Content License, https://pixabay.com/service/license-summary/):
Vinyl Needle Drop — u_xg7ssi08yr, https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/vinyl-needle-drop-572432/
059550_Record Player — freesound_community, https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/059550-record-player-90330/
Supplied by user as lp start.mp3 (5.747 s) and lp end.mp3 (1.368 s). Converted to Ogg without trimming or pitch changes. Playback uses existing softened game audio bus.

Boss preview: roll-soft combines existing credited cloth with synthesized rounded contacts. zap-soft, phone-soft, chime-soft, wind-soft are locally synthesized, gently filtered original effects (scripts/make-boss-audio.py).

Boss refinement: phone-soft-0/1/2, billiard-soft, air-soft and revised chime/wind are locally synthesized gentle cues; roll-soft and slime-soft also reuse credited existing cloth/bubble recordings. See scripts/refine-boss-audio.py.

Local preview revision: church-bell uses Church Bell, Joseph SARDIN, CC0, https://bigsoundbank.com/church-bell-s0135.html (trimmed first strike, gentle lowpass and fade). firework-soft uses CC0 Firecracker with wick #4, https://bigsoundbank.com/firecracker-with-wick-4-s1140.html (softened attack, muffled tail and short reflections). fuse-soft uses CC0 Slow wick 1, Joseph SARDIN, https://bigsoundbank.com/slow-wick-1--s1306.html (loop excerpt, filtered). zap-note-0..4 are original synthesized pentatonic electrical tones.

User-supplied local-preview audio: chimeBell.mp3 -> chime-user.ogg, churchBell.mp3 -> church-user.ogg (original pitch, no EQ). Still Alive.mp3 is retained at music/still-alive.mp3 for this private local test only. Blackhole hum and MIDI-note cloud voice are original synthesis. Cloud scores are original short arrangements of public-domain Beethoven Ode to Joy, Twinkle Twinkle (Mozart variation theme), and traditional Greensleeves.

Local preview refinements: phone-key-0..11 are original standard DTMF keypad tone synthesis (12 keys; four presses per laser). phase-soft is original filtered noise / sine synthesis. Cloud chords are original short progressions rendered with a softly band-limited electrical harmonic waveform.

church-short.ogg: supplied churchBell strike cropped to 240 ms with an exponential tail fade. cake-heavy.ogg: original low sine / filtered-noise synthesis for a cushioned heavy landing.

Blackhole dial: locally synthesized soft DTMF 697/1209 Hz, 1.3 seconds. Church short: user-provided churchBell strike, 0.6-second rounded decay.
